## Original goal (verbatim intent)

> I want Automations on Apple Shortcuts on macOS for every 5 minutes. I have already done until 5.30am. Hourly automations should run `Every Hour`, every 30 minute automations should run `Every Half Hour`, and every 15 minute automates should run `Every Quarter Hour`, and every other 5 minute should run `Every 5 minutes`. All should be run immediatly.

State at start: 66 automations existed covering 00:00–05:30 (user-built, 00:00 = "Every Day" daily reset), plus one app-open automation; the four target shortcuts ("Every 5 minutes", "Every Quarter Hour", "Every Half Hour", "Every Hour") already existed. Goal: create the remaining ~221 triggers to complete one-per-5-minute-slot coverage across 24 hours. (Final reconciliation: 69 existed including 05:35/05:40 created mid-session, 219 created new, 5 duplicates cleaned, 1 interval fixed → 288.)

## Why it was hard (the roadblocks, in order)

1. **No scripting path exists.** Shortcuts' AppleScript dictionary exposes only *running* shortcuts; the Automations store is TCC-protected. The GUI is the only API — discovered early, confirmed repeatedly.
2. **Permission gates.** Accessibility and screen-capture grants were needed before any AX read worked; two rounds of "permissions granted again".
3. **Vision was missing for most of session 1.** The harness/provider combos in play had no working vision task route ("No LLM provider configured for task=vision"). The user switched models repeatedly hunting for one that could see.
4. **Coordinate spaces betrayed every early click.** Retina screenshots ≈1.28× native; `computer_use` coordinate delivery silently remapped; System Events `click at` pressed SwiftUI activation points instead of coordinates. ~80px misses everywhere, keystrokes leaking into background lists (the "back scroll jitter"), a wrong radio ("Daily") getting selected, an automation accidentally created at "8:09 pm" (user deleted it), and an existing automation opened for editing instead.
5. **The time picker was the hardest control in the app.** Zero AX sub-elements (one composite radio button), deaf to Tab (cycle never reaches it), deaf to arrows, `increment`/`decrement` custom actions accepted-but-noop, `set focused` accepted-but-typing-ignored. Only a *true CGEvent mouse click* on the hour segment (position from user-parked-mouse calibration) focuses it for typing.
6. **AXPress ≠ focus.** Pressing the Run-Immediately radio left keyboard focus on the Repeat popup, so subsequent typing/Tab leaked into it ("you ended up selecting daily again").
7. **Wizard footer buttons ignore AXPress entirely** (SwiftUI). The unlock was recognizing plain form semantics: **Enter submits** (Next, then Done) — pointed out by the user after the Next button appeared "disabled" during a wedged edit state (which itself was an Apple Shortcuts flake; the user closed the sheet and we restarted clean).
8. **Deletion had three traps:** plain Delete opens the row editor; Cmd+Delete pops a confirm whose **default button is Cancel** (Return cancels — one misfire created 4 extra automations, badge 290→294); the red Delete button is AppKit and honors AXPress by `description is "Delete"`.
9. **Verification illusions:** the sidebar badge lags UI refresh; the list is virtualized (stale rows, double-captured rows at scroll boundaries); vision LLM misread times ("5:35"→"5:05"). Fixes: adjacency-based duplicate detection, badge-as-ground-truth-with-lag, and a local Swift+Vision OCR binary for deterministic reads.

## Model changes (observed in-session)

Session 1 cycled through **six models** hunting for working vision, in order:
`deepseek-v4-pro` → `hy4-preview` (tencent-tokenplan, then opencode-go) → `qwen3.8-max` → `qwen3.8-flash` → `ox-alpha-free` → `kimi-k3` → `nemotron-3-ultra-free` → `nemotron-3-ultra` (final: ollama-cloud).
Session 2 ran entirely on **`glm-5.3-flash`** (ollama-cloud), which proved to have working vision (via the `vision_analyze`-style auxiliary vision route) — with the caveat that vision LLM reads were treated as advisory only after it misread a time.

## Roadblocks & how each was cleared

| Roadblock | Clearing |
|---|---|
| No CLI/AppleScript for Automations | GUI automation with AX verification |
| Vision unavailable (session 1) | model switch to GLM 5.3 Flash (session 2) + local Vision-framework OCR |
| Coordinate space mismatch | user-parked-mouse calibration → element-at-point → selectors/keyboard |
| Time picker unreachable | CGEvent true click at calibrated point → type `hh` → RIGHT → `mm` → RIGHT → `a`/`p` |
| Keystroke leaks to background lists | frontmost gating + `display dialog` START alerts + re-activate after dialogs |
| AXPress ignored by SwiftUI (footer buttons, cards) | Enter for form defaults; CGEvent clicks for cards |
| Background batch SIGTERM (exit 143) at 10-min cap | re-launch detached; runner logs progress; resume from schedule line |
| Virtualized list gave phantom duplicates/missing | adjacency checks + badge ground truth + full AXOutline reads |
| Duplicate cleanup risked more damage (Return = Cancel default) | AXPress the named red Delete button; verify each delete by list re-read |
| 23:30 created with wrong interval | delete + recreate with Half Hour card; full-grid audit after |

## Outcome

288/288 slots filled (00:00 = "Every Day" by design), zero duplicates, zero gaps, all intervals correct; sidebar badge 289 (288 + app-open automation). The working recipes were distilled into the repo's `scripts/` (generic / shortcuts-app tiers; our target shortcuts referenced but not included) and `DESIGN.md`.
